routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of about 110 states, including the US, Canada, UK, Japan, Australia and most EU states, can enter without a visa. Holders of valid EU, Schengen, UK, US or Canadian residence permits or visas may also be exempt. Check the official list.

other: The page did not state how many days you can stay. Check the official list for the stay limit.

routes.name: Short stay visa (e-visa or consulate)
routes.summary: Citizens of about 100 states, mostly in Africa, Asia and the Middle East, need a visa. Some also need an official invitation. The MFA page points to the evisa.gov.md portal.

other: Fees, stay limits and e-visa eligibility were not on the page. The evisa.gov.md portal could not be read.

routes.name: Airport transit visa
routes.summary: Nationals of a separate listed set of states need a visa just to pass through the transit area of a Moldovan airport.

other: Check the official list of nationalities.

routes.name: Right of temporary stay (90 days to 1 year)
routes.summary: Lets certain foreign workers stay more than 90 days up to one year without a residence permit. Categories: professional sellers, contractual service providers, independent professionals, seasonal farm workers, cross-border workers and IT specialists.

other: Contractual service providers: contract up to 12 months and 3 years of experience.
Independent professionals: contract up to 12 months and proof of study or 6 years of experience.
IT specialists: opinion from the IT authority and a service contract.

documents: Contract, where the category needs one
steps: Apply at a Foreigner Documentation Single Window (Chisinau, Balti, Cahul or Comrat).

routes.name: Permanent residence for spouse of a Moldovan citizen
routes.summary: A foreign spouse of a Moldovan citizen can apply for permanent residence. Apply at least 90 days before your authorized stay ends. The page did not give a required number of years or a fee.

eligibility.language: State language certificate, not needed for old-age pension recipients
other: Proof of housing and Moldovan health insurance.
Criminal record from home country, apostilled.

routes.name: Citizenship by recognition (descent and historical ties)
routes.summary: For people born in Moldova without proof of citizenship, people with a parent, grandparent or great-grandparent born in Moldova, and certain Bessarabia, North Bukovina or deported-family descendants.

sources.label: Acquisition of citizenship by recognition, Embassy of Moldova to the US

citizenship.note: Up to great-grandparent born in Moldova. Embassy page lists fees of 35 and 56 USD and about 9 months. Dual citizenship rules were not on the page.

routes.processing: About 9 months, per the embassy page.

routes.name: Work and other residence permits
routes.summary: Moldova issues residence permits for work, study, family and other grounds through IGM. The details, fees and in-demand job list were not readable on the pages reached.

other: Conditions and fees not confirmed. See the IGM services pages and the 2026 state fee PDF at igm.gov.md.
